title: Tropical Beach Trio
description: Three women in revealing swimwear pose on a large fallen palm tree on a tropical beach at dusk. The woman on the left has intricate back tattoos and braided hair, the center woman wears a star-patterned bikini, and the blonde woman on the right wears a dark blue corset-style top with glowing neon signs visible in the background.
prompt: Three beautiful women posing on a large fallen palm tree on a sandy tropical beach at sunset. The right woman is a blonde in a dark blue lace-up corset top and black bottoms.
